However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. Completed service contract includes on-going service contract subject to payment of bills amou nting to at least 35% of the advertised value of the bid. 2) DEFINITION OF SIMILAR TYPE OF WORK:- For the subject work “Management of Running room se rvices and supply of readymade subsidized meals to running staff in running room”, The Definition o f similar work approved by PCEE/Central Railway is as under, “Housekeeping along with catering (including meals) of Railway running Rooms/Railway rest house/Railway Training Institute hostels/Public Sector Undertakings/ any other insta llation/office of Central Government/State Government, OR of public listed company/priva te company/Trusts (having annual turnover of Rs 500 crore and above subject to the wor k completion certificate being issued from their Head office by a person of the company duly enclosing his authorization by the Management for issuing such credentials).” B. If the last Financial Year Balance sheet is not audited only then Provisional Balance sheet of last fina ncial year duly certified by chartered accountant with stamp, signature and membership number sh ould be submitted along with the Bid.
